name: FrostCraft
detailed_description:
FrostCraft is a 3rd person cozy Adventure/LifeSim set in a big, snowy world covered in endless winter. A magical disaster froze everything, but hope remains, and this hope is You! Build a cozy settlement under a magical dome of the last Tree of Life, and bring warmth back to the land.

❄ Explore a Frozen World

Wander through snowy lands, discover new regions, gather rare resources, and piece together forgotten stories. As you progress, unlock new fun ways to travel and overcome the freezing weather — from handcrafted snow-gliders to powerful magical artifacts.

🏠 Build Your Warm Haven

Create, expand and decorate your perfect little village under the dome. Construct homes, workshops, farms, paths, decorations and all stuff that makes it feel like home. Shape your oasis the way you want. Do everything yourself, or let your settlers help while you go on adventures.

🤝 Invite Others Under the Dome

You're not alone in this frozen world. Meet survivors and discover lost outposts. Learn their stories, offer them help, and invite some to live under your dome. Each character brings unique talents to your growing community.

🌡 Unique Thermal Contrast Mechanics

The contrast between your warm dome and the frozen world is at the heart of FrostCraft. Use heat wisely and play with how the world reacts — ice melts, water freezes, and materials behave differently depending on the temperature. Solve creative challenges and build smarter.

🔧 Crafting, Farming, and Cozy Living

Grow plants, raise animals, and craft everything from tools to decorations. Or just focus on exploring and let your villagers handle the chores. It’s your world — play the way you like.

🧩 Unravel the Mystery

What really happened to this world? Why did everything freeze? Explore ancient ruins, magical tech, and hidden secrets. Maybe you can do more than just survive — maybe you can bring life back to the land.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
